propositions: Git fetch hangs (>300s, 2/25 reproducible) on GitHub timeouts trigger review-error decision which voter converts to fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote
The fail-closed -1 vote suppresses backfill reconciler re-drive, blocking automatic recovery and requiring manual re-trigger

Retryable failure conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled, process-teardown) should cast no vote and leave changes vote-less for reconciler backfill instead of fail-closed veto
Shutdown drain window (45s) is too short for in-flight reviews (measured 260-911s), causing teardown-corrupted fail-closed votes during extended reviews
Defer vote-less for retryable gaps up to a bounded attempt limit (default 3), then escalate to fail-closed -1 with retries-exhausted note and VOTER_ERROR metric
Increase shutdown drain to full review timeout (1200s) and stop_grace_period to 1320s to let in-flight reviews complete without interruption
